injuries.name: Derrick White
injuries.short_comment: White (shoulder) is questionable to play in Saturday's game against Sacramento.
injuries.long_comment: White is dealing with a left AC joint contusion, and the ailment could force him to miss his first outing of the season. Across 15 games in 2026-27, White is averaging 12.7 points, 3.0 rebounds, 5.0 assists, 1.1 steals, 0.7 blocks and 1.7 three-pointers in 29.9 minutes. If he's unable to play, Payton Pritchard may join the starting lineup, while Hugo Gonzalez and Baylor Scheierman should see a bump in minutes off the bench.

injuries.name: Jayson Tatum
injuries.short_comment: Tatum (rest) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Sacramento.
injuries.long_comment: Tatum might not play Saturday against the Kings, the first game of a back-to-back. If he doesn't suit up, it could result in more work for Luka Garza, Sam Hauser and Jordan Walsh.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.short_comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
injuries.long_comment: Simmons had a quality preseason, averaging 10.5 points, 4.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists over 17.4 minutes per contest (two games). The 30-year-old was on track to suit up for the Kings on opening night, though those plans were halted after he suffered a torn Achilles tendon during practice. Now, Simmons will focus on rehab. However, it's unknown what the future holds regarding his career in the NBA.

injuries.name: Precious Achiuwa
injuries.short_comment: Achiuwa (lower leg) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Lakers.
injuries.long_comment: Achiuwa will miss the front end of this back-to-back set due to a lower-leg contusion, and his next chance to play will come against Boston on Saturday. With the 27-year-old sidelined, Dylan Cardwell and Alex Karaban are candidates for increased playing time.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.short_comment: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.
injuries.long_comment: Raynaud continues to get ruled out a full day in advance of tipoff, suggesting he's still not close. He should be considered week-to-week moving forward.
